reviews.x: The tie on top is not adjustable so the soap falls out. The corners are super scratchy and fall apart easily. I wasn't looking for anything spectacular with these but a simple slip knot on the top to keep the soap in would've been enough for me to at least give it 3 stars.

reviews.t: Nice solution to using all of the bar of soap
reviews.x: I've been using liquid body wash years but started thinking about the plastic waste from the bottles and went looking for a solution that would allow me to use bar soap but not end up with the slivers left over. This seems like a reasonable compromise. The mesh bags hold the soap and allow you to use all of it, down to the very last tiny piece. They foam up nice and the mesh bag provides a bit of scrubbing like I'd get from a standard shower puff. It's a bit tricky to use when switching from han

These are cheaply made and eventually tear apart.  The worst part about them, is they lather way too much and wastes most of my soap down the drain. They use a double net (more than likely because they know the material is going to break so this way when it does, you will not lose the soap due to the other surrounding net.).  This causes it to lather more than normal. 2 broke in the first couple times in use. The nets also need to have bigger holes, these smaller ones are not ideal for bathing.

My customers love these bags for their soaps! Helps to save the soap a little better!  UPDATE: the bags are a nice soap saver, but customers are having to buy new ones every  couple of weeks. The bags become stretched and rip. It’s a little hard to scrub with but people still love them They are great when using soaps with exfoliant in them to keep from scratching up the skin.

I'm honestly surprised how well these work! I recently switched back to bar soap but I was missing the lather and bubbles. I put a bar of soap in, tie a knot around the top, and that's it. It works like a loofah to create lots of suds. At this price, I'll probably just toss them as I use each bar. Bonus, after you knot it, you can use the loop to hang your bar from a shower caddy or hook so your bar stays dry and doesn't get goopy.
Love these! Huge rave from my family. Lathers very nicely the exfoliation is very gentle.

We ended up buying some soaps from a friend and these have come in handy! We hang all the soaps on a towel rack right outside of shower.  Now the soaps do stick to the material after being dried but that is of not bother to me.  I just wet it and take the soap out.  My daughter does wash with the bag and she loves it. I would buy again but I would get the bigger one as we have lots of soap to try.

I am very happy to have this hanging in my shower! An amazing amount of foam is easily created from any bar of soap. It is also easy to use every last bit of every bar. I have passed along to others and I travel with mine. I have very sensitive skin and have had no issues with the gentle exfoliating provided. Terrific product!

It’s a good bag in that it’s double layered, but the ribbon they used to sinch it closed doesn’t stay tied. I wound up tying a knot in it which presents its own obvious problems. Overall, it does create nice bubbles to wash with, but beware- it does make your bar soap disappear faster!
I did end up having to tie these closed to keep the soap in, but that doesn't bother me. They work great and it's nice to be able to use up the soap bars I've got lying around.
These produce way more lather than a traditional bar of soap by itself. One bag lasts me about 3 bars before I replace it. Have already purchased for family members.

I had purchased these in an effort to reduce my plastic waste...thinking I would stop purchasing body wash in plastic bottles and instead use bar soap with these to still create a nice lather.  I was disappointed to see that each of the 20 soap holders was individually wrapped in its own plastic film and all 20 were packaged together in another layer of plastic film.  If you’re trying to reduce your plastic waste, I do not recommend these.  I also developed a skin irritation the same day I start

The baggies came very quickly, which was great, but I’m not sure they are actually anything special for using for soap. They are just thin nylon with a ribbon on top to pull shut. That’s fine though since they are so cheap. My biggest concern is that they came tied up in a little grocery bag which was then put into a regular clear bag for products. Lots of plastic and a bit questionable…

I use homemade soap and bought these little sacks to make using my soap more convenient!  I love all the lather they produce and have given a few away with bars of my soap and the recipients loved them, as well.  I tie a loose knot in the top and when the soap runs out, I let the ribbon dry, undo the knot, load with new soap and it works perfectly. Great buy, great product!

I'm not sure why suction power is an option for review because these dont have suction cups. As far as the product, I love them! They are double layered and soft mesh. They are perfect to give my customers who purchase soap. I use them myself and they help create a really nice lather.

I give these out with my handmade soap and everyone loves them.  They help the soap bubble even more than it already does and you can hang them up so the soap dries in between uses and lasts longer.  Highly recommend.

reviews.t: Really good. Work great. Good quality.
reviews.x: I was really surprised with these because I was expecting something cheap that would tear to shreds the first time I used it. But they're really good and they work really well and I was very surprised at the quality.
I've only had these a couple of weeks, and five have already broken (the end of the bag slips open with regular use).  Save your money, look for something of better quality.
I have hard water that can make sudsing sub problematic. This worked wonders, dries quick, and fits the different shaped and sized bars I’ve tried.
My husband uses bars of soap and can’t keep ahold of it in the shower. These bags really help!
I liked that these bags were longer than others I purchased.

i like this product for the most part, but the tie doesn't stay together,and the little bead on the end comes off.I used a soap infused with herbs and put it in the sack and it kept coming loose,and all the little herbs got all over my tub, the reason I wanted to use this was so it wouldn't get everywhere, but it did,then i had a mess to deal with.I will use the rest of them maybe i will try a hair tie,or a clip, because otherwise I like it.

I thought theses would be awesome but they were just okay. I put a soap bar in the first one I used and the cord moved and the soap started to fall out. They’d be better if the portion of the body where the cord sits was stitched so that it didn’t move. They’re a great deal for the money and maybe with smaller soap or soap pieces it would work much better.

Every year we send Holiday boxes oversees and bar soap is one of the items we include.  This product is perfect to store the soap.  Many countries we send boxes to have communal baths.  Great way to store soap and use as wash cloth.  Great lather and doesn't gum up after several uses.  Hang by rope closure.  So impressed we started to use at home.

These soap savers are a good thickness and soft. Improvements need to be made, there is no way to close the bag. The drawstring provided doesn’t keep the bag closed so you need to tie a knot in it to keep the bag closed. Overall, it will do the job. I haven’t used them very long to be able to attest to longevity.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the bags for producing abundant lather and foam from bar soap.
Several reviewers note the bags help use up every last bit of the soap bar.
Some reviewers report the bags are cheaply made and tear or rip apart, sometimes within a couple of weeks.
Multiple reviewers mention the closure ribbon doesn't stay tied, requiring them to knot it to keep soap in.
A few reviewers complain the bags make soap disappear or waste it faster.
